gbifID.description: Global Biodiversity Information Facility unique identifier for each species occurrence record.

datasetKey.description: Unique identifier linking records to the source biodiversity dataset.

occurrenceID.description: Unique iNaturalist observation URLs identifying each Asota plana species record.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom classification for all recorded Asota plana species occurrences.

phylum.description: Taxonomic phylum classification for all recorded Asota plana species occurrences.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the recorded Asota plana species occurrences.

order.description: Taxonomic order classification for all recorded Asota plana species occurrences.

family.description: Taxonomic family classification for all recorded Asota plana species occurrences.

genus.description: Taxonomic genus name of the recorded species, consistently Asota.

species.description: Scientific name of the recorded species, consistently Asota plana.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Specific epithet identifying the subspecies, such as lacteata, within the Asota plana species.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of the recorded Asota plana species occurrence.

scientificName.description: Scientific name and author citation of the recorded Asota plana species or subspecies.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded Asota plana species or subspecies.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: No verbatim scientific name authorship data is available in this dataset.

countryCode.description: Two-letter ISO country codes indicating the location of species occurrences.

locality.description: Locality data is entirely missing from all records.

stateProvince.description: Geographic location of Asota plana species occurrences across various states and provinces.

occurrenceStatus.description: Presence of Asota plana species at recorded locations.

individualCount.description: No data available for individual count records.

publishingOrgKey.description: Unique identifier for the organization publishing the species occurrence records.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude coordinates in decimal degrees for species occurrence locations.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude coordinates in decimal degrees for recorded species locations.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Circular radius in meters defining the uncertainty of recorded geographic coordinates.

coordinatePrecision.description: No data available for coordinate precision in this dataset.

elevation.description: No elevation data is available for these Asota plana species occurrence records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy data is entirely missing from all records.

depth.description: No depth measurements are recorded for any species occurrence.

depthAccuracy.description: No depth accuracy data is recorded for any species occurrence.

eventDate.description: Date and time of each Asota plana species occurrence observation.

day.description: Day of the month when the Asota plana species occurrence was recorded.

month.description: Month of occurrence for Asota plana species records, ranging from 1 to 12.

year.description: Calendar year of each Asota plana species occurrence record.

taxonKey.description: Unique alphanumeric identifiers for Asota plana species occurrence records.

speciesKey.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier for the Asota plana species within the dataset.

basisOfRecord.description: Human observation records the method of data collection for all entries.

institutionCode.description: iNaturalist serves as the sole data source institution for all records.

collectionCode.description: Collection method recorded as Observations for all species occurrence records.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each Asota plana species occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: No data exists for this column as all values are null.

identifiedBy.description: Names of individuals who identified the Asota plana species records.

dateIdentified.description: Timestamp of the date when the Asota plana specimen was identified.

license.description: Creative Commons license type governing the use of species occurrence records.

rightsHolder.description: Names of individuals or organizations holding rights to the species occurrence records.

recordedBy.description: Names of individuals or groups who recorded Asota plana species occurrences.

typeStatus.description: No type status values are recorded for any species occurrence.

establishmentMeans.description: No establishment means data recorded for any Asota plana occurrence.

lastInterpreted.description: Timestamp of the most recent data interpretation for each occurrence record.

mediaType.description: Media type of occurrence records, primarily StillImage with semicolon-separated multiple entries.

issue.description: Lists data quality issues like coordinate rounding and missing taxon identifiers.

asota_plana.description: This table contains 996 Asota plana species occurrence records from 2005 to 2026.

description: This dataset contains 996 records of Asota plana species occurrences from 2005 to 2026.
